novelty.mechanism_link: Novelty not established: conditional Wan-specific observation about compensated error direction under original-group QDQ and fastest implementable support granularity must be observed before any claim. Bare Gram/QCQP and routing are prior art.

nearest_prior_art.comparison: AISTATS 2022 already models quadratic channel coupling/resource-constrained structured selection; generic Gram criterion is not novel.
ICLR 2026 diffusion pruning accounts for denoising-timestep error accumulation; cannot claim trajectory sensitivity alone.
TARDIS uses partially linear FFN folding/nonlinear restoration; R2 affine design is transfer.
PrunePath supplies prior structured FFN routing.
Spark uses predictor-informed activation sparsity, making prediction/router alone non-novel.

decisions.reason: Read current numerical QDQ semantics, live binding and OP2 source assets before using Gram surrogate or assuming K1 identity.
Native signed advantage identity, fixed-operand quadratic proxy, and hierarchy of free oracle granularity are settled conditional algebra.
Frozen UB1 picked K before residual compensation; prioritize equal-budget static support alternatives, no online router before testing their true native value.
Do not build tile router until coarse conditional advantage and pre-W1 predictability exist; current runtime uses one packed weight per position.
Run native quality continuation only after actual support improvement and exact resume are established.
